title: Arch's shrink ray
description: This project adds a shrink ray that makes the player small on use.
body:
(if u need support https://discord.gg/dEKszSFwzT or dm me zayavka) **TESTED ON PURPURMC 1.21.11 IF U HAVE ANY PROBLEMS GO TO SUPPORT DISCORD** Adds Arch's shrink ray that lets u become small for 15 or 45 sceonds. The 15s shrink ray makes u wait 45 seconds after u became big again, And the 45 seconds one just lets u use it right after. There is currently no crafting recipe but to get the shrink rays u can use:
`function archsshrinkray:give/power1` (15s one)
`function archsshrinkray:give/power2` (45s one) Dont be scared that it looks like pink glazed terracota, its actually a clock, u cant do anything with it.
